title: MiniMax H3 Tool component manifest
description: Immutable embedded-app authority for expected component artifacts. The manifest grants neither download/materialization nor deletion authority.

extensions.description: Omitted means that no display-only extension metadata is present.

external_binding_requirement.description: A separately signed build inventory must bind app_id, app_version, app_build_id, catalog_resource and this document's integrity.content_sha256. This literal is a requirement declaration, not self-attestation proof.

entry_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the JCS array of regular-file entry records sorted by unsigned UTF-8 path bytes; each record is exactly {artifact_sha256,byte_length,path,type}, with type regular_file.

expanded_tree_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical_regular_files_v1 binary frame over the verified extracted regular-file tree; the exact frame is defined by this schema family's README.

dependencies.description: An empty array means that this component has no component-manifest dependency edge.

signature.description: Omitted means that no signature metadata is declared; omission never implies trust.
